title_as_printed: (Gas + gas) equilibria for {(1 - x)C3H8 + xH2O}: upper solution temperatures T as a function of pressure p for a given mole fraction x
pressure_note: pressure from pressure balance; total pressure of the homogeneous/two-fluid-phase boundary (isopleth)

value.what: upper solution temperature: fluid-phase boundary (dew/bubble/critical region) at fixed overall composition x(H2O) and pressure; second fluid phase appears below this T

composition.other_species: set per block via label rows: x = mole fraction H2O in {(1-x)C3H8 + xH2O}

notes: Fluid-fluid (gas+gas type) phase boundary isopleths at water-rich overall compositions, 585-660 K; the composition is overall mole fraction, not the water content of a coexisting gas phase. Pairs (p,T) printed in four column-pairs per row; stacked column by column (first printed column pair top to bottom, then second, ...). Printed order retained, including non-monotonic entries (x=0.900: 41.19 then 40.31; 33.53 then 33.50) and the repeated 623.0-region values.
